description: Test suite for Google OAuth token helper functions, including formatting and parsing of OAuth credentials.

methods.name: formatGoogleOauthApiKey
methods.description: Formats OAuth credentials with project-aware payloads into JSON string or returns empty string if not OAuth.

methods.name: parseGoogleOauthApiKey
methods.description: Parses a JSON string representing OAuth credentials, returning structured fields or the raw string.

methods.name: parseGoogleUsageToken
methods.description: Extracts token string from JSON payload or returns raw input if not JSON.
